title: Introduce temporal-weighted exemplar replay and adaptive prefetch CI-hook
author: Asha Menon
release_notes: Add a temporal-weighted exemplar replay CI hook and an adaptive prefetch scheduler to reduce false positive regressions for time-sensitive prompt sets; no API changes.
description: Context: Some production prompt-sets show temporal drift and intermittent regressions that standard anchor replay misses because anchors age out or are not representatively sampled. This PR adds two related pieces: a temporal-weighted exemplar replay hook for CI and an adaptive prefetch/prober that warms the eval cache with time-representative examples before heavy smoke runs. Motivation: reduce noisy regression alerts and improve early detection of degradations tied to temporal distribution shifts. What I changed: implemented a replay strategy that assigns higher sampling weight to recent examples while preserving long-tail anchors, added a prefetch scheduler that monitors recent traffic distributions and seeds the eval runner cache, and exposed lightweight knobs in configs for half-life and prefetch window. Tests and validation: unit tests for scheduler and weighting, integration smoke harness runs against three production prompt cohorts, and a controlled A/B run showing an 18% reduction in spurious regression alerts and a 12% increase in early-detection hits during the last 7-day window. Performance: prefetch adds approximately 1.8s median to CI job startup but reduces total rerun time downstream by about 22% in failing cases. Backwards compatibility: defaults preserve existing sampling behavior unless the feature is enabled in config. Checklist: ensure Linear ticket ENG-1913 referenced, add docs entry, add integration test coverage, verify Docker build. Related: follow-up will add a visual dashboard for temporal coverage.
